<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <meta name="description" content="Colosal Cookies — galletas artesanales en Mexicali, BC." />
  <title>Colosal Cookies | Mexicali</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --wine:#5f160f;
      --wine-2:#7c2418;
      --cream:#fff4df;
      --paper:#fffaf2;
      --ink:#2a1712;
      --muted:#7a655e;
      --gold:#c99858;
      --shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(61,20,14,.14);
    }

    * { box-sizing:border-box; }
    html { scroll-behavior:smooth; }
    body {
      margin:0;
      background:var(--paper);
      color:var(--ink);
      font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }
    a { color:inherit; text-decoration:none; }
    img { display:block; max-width:100%; }

    .nav {
      position:sticky;
      top:0;
      z-index:20;
      backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
      background:rgba(255,250,242,.84);
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(95,22,15,.08);
    }
    .nav-inner {
      max-width:1180px;
      margin:auto;
      padding:14px 24px;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:space-between;
      gap:20px;
    }
    .brand {
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:12px;
      font-weight:800;
      letter-spacing:.2px;
    }
    .brand-mark {
      width:42px;
      height:42px;
      border-radius:50%;
      overflow:hidden;
      box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(95,22,15,.18);
    }
    .brand-mark img {
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      object-fit:cover;
    }
    .nav-links {
      display:flex;
      gap:26px;
      font-size:14px;
      font-weight:600;
      color:#5e4a43;
    }
    .nav-cta {
      padding:11px 18px;
      background:var(--wine);
      color:white;
      border-radius:999px;
      font-weight:700;
      box-shadow:0 9px 22px rgba(95,22,15,.18);
    }

    .hero {
      min-height:78vh;
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;
      align-items:center;
      max-width:1180px;
      margin:auto;
      padding:70px 24px 60px;
      gap:54px;
    }
    .eyebrow {
      color:var(--wine-2);
      font-weight:800;
      letter-spacing:2px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      font-size:12px;
      margin-bottom:18px;
    }
    h1 {
      margin:0;
      font-family:Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      font-size:clamp(52px, 7vw, 94px);
      line-height:.93;
      letter-spacing:-3px;
      color:var(--wine);
    }
    .hero p {
      max-width:600px;
      font-size:19px;
      line-height:1.7;
      color:#654f47;
      margin:26px 0 30px;
    }
    .hero-actions {
      display:flex;
      gap:14px;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
    }
    .btn {
      display:inline-flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:10px;
      min-height:48px;
      padding:0 20px;
      border-radius:999px;
      font-weight:800;
      transition:.25s ease;
    }
    .btn-primary {
      background:var(--wine);
      color:#fff;
      box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(95,22,15,.18);
    }
    .btn-secondary {
      border:1px solid rgba(95,22,15,.22);
      background:#fff9f0;
    }
    .btn:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); }

    .hero-art {
      position:relative;
      min-height:520px;
      display:grid;
      place-items:center;
    }
    .hero-card {
      width:min(480px, 92%);
      aspect-ratio:4/5;
      border-radius:34px;
      overflow:hidden;
      box-shadow:var(--shadow);
      transform:rotate(2deg);
      border:8px solid rgba(255,255,255,.78);
      background:var(--wine);
    }
    .hero-card img {
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      object-fit:cover;
    }
    .badge {
      position:absolute;
      left:0;
      bottom:56px;
      background:#fff;
      border:1px solid rgba(95,22,15,.1);
      border-radius:18px;
      padding:15px 18px;
      box-shadow:var(--shadow);
      font-size:14px;
      line-height:1.35;
    }
    .badge strong { display:block; color:var(--wine); font-size:17px; }

    .section {
      max-width:1180px;
      margin:auto;
      padding:85px 24px;
    }
    .section-title {
      max-width:740px;
      margin-bottom:34px;
    }
    .section-title h2 {
      font-family:Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      color:var(--wine);
      font-size:clamp(38px,5vw,60px);
      margin:0 0 12px;
      line-height:1;
    }
    .section-title p {
      margin:0;
      color:var(--muted);
      font-size:17px;
      line-height:1.7;
    }

    .menu-grid {
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap:38px;
      align-items:start;
    }
    .menu-copy {
      background:var(--wine);
      color:white;
      border-radius:30px;
      padding:34px;
      box-shadow:var(--shadow);
      position:sticky;
      top:92px;
    }
    .menu-copy h3 {
      font-family:Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      font-size:38px;
      margin:0 0 14px;
    }
    .menu-copy p {
      margin:0 0 18px;
      line-height:1.7;
      color:#f5dfd6;
    }
    .menu-points {
      display:grid;
      gap:12px;
      margin:22px 0 26px;
    }
    .menu-points div {
      padding:12px 14px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
      border-radius:14px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);
      font-size:14px;
    }
    .menu-img {
      border-radius:28px;
      overflow:hidden;
      box-shadow:var(--shadow);
      border:1px solid rgba(95,22,15,.10);
      background:white;
    }

    .story {
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff5e2 0%,#f7ead5 100%);
      border-radius:34px;
      padding:48px;
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
      gap:42px;
      align-items:center;
    }
    .story .photo {
      border-radius:28px;
      overflow:hidden;
      box-shadow:var(--shadow);
      background:white;
    }
    .story h3 {
      font-family:Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      font-size:42px;
      color:var(--wine);
      margin:0 0 16px;
    }
    .story p {
      color:#6a554d;
      line-height:1.75;
      margin:0 0 14px;
    }

    .cta {
      margin:50px auto 90px;
      max-width:1180px;
      padding:0 24px;
    }
    .cta-box {
      background:var(--wine);
      color:white;
      border-radius:32px;
      padding:48px;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:space-between;
      gap:24px;
      box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    }
    .cta-box h3 {
      font-family:Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      font-size:40px;
      margin:0 0 10px;
    }
    .cta-box p {
      margin:0;
      color:#f2dcd3;
    }
    .cta-box .btn {
      background:var(--cream);
      color:var(--wine);
      white-space:nowrap;
    }

    footer {
      border-top:1px solid rgba(95,22,15,.10);
      color:#756159;
      padding:26px 24px;
    }
    .footer-inner {
      max-width:1180px;
      margin:auto;
      display:flex;
      justify-content:space-between;
      gap:20px;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
      font-size:14px;
    }

    @media (max-width:900px) {
      .nav-links { display:none; }
      .hero { grid-template-columns:1fr; padding-top:50px; }
      .hero-art { min-height:440px; }
      .menu-grid, .story { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
      .menu-copy { position:static; }
      .cta-box { flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; }
    }

    @media (max-width:560px) {
      .nav-inner { padding:12px 16px; }
      .hero, .section, .cta { padding-left:16px; padding-right:16px; }
      h1 { letter-spacing:-2px; }
      .hero-art { min-height:370px; }
      .badge { left:10px; bottom:24px; }
      .story { padding:26px; }
      .cta-box { padding:30px; }
    }
  
    /* MENU LAYOUT FIX */
    .menu-grid {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 420px) minmax(0, 440px);
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: start;
      gap: 38px;
    }

    .menu-img {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 440px;
      justify-self: center;
      border-radius: 28px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      border: 1px solid rgba(95,22,15,.10);
      background: transparent;
      line-height: 0;
    }

    .menu-img img {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      max-width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
    }

    @media (max-width:900px) {
      .menu-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .menu-img {
        width: min(100%, 520px);
      }
    }

</style>
</head>
<body>

  <nav class="nav">
    <div class="nav-inner">
      <a class="brand" href="#inicio">
        <span class="brand-mark"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Colosal Cookies logo"></span>
        <span>Colosal Cookies</span>
      </a>

      <div class="nav-links">
        <a href="#menu">Menú</a>
        <a href="#nosotros">Nosotros</a>
        <a href="#instagram">Instagram</a>
      </div>

      <a class="nav-cta" href="https://www.instagram.com/colosalcookies/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
        Hacer pedido
      </a>
    </div>
  </nav>

  <main>
    <section class="hero" id="inicio">
      <div>
        <div class="eyebrow">Mexicali, Baja California</div>
        <h1>Cookies<br>hechas para<br>antojar.</h1>
        <p>
          Galletas artesanales con rellenos generosos, combinaciones irresistibles
          y una presentación que se siente tan especial como el primer bocado.
        </p>
        <div class="hero-actions">
          <a class="btn btn-primary" href="#menu">Ver menú</a>
          <a class="btn btn-secondary" href="https://www.instagram.com/colosalcookies/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
            @colosalcookies
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="hero-art">
        <div class="hero-card">
          <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Identidad visual Colosal Cookies">
        </div>
        <div class="badge">
          <strong>Cookies artesanales</strong>
          Pedidos por Instagram · Mexicali BC
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="section" id="menu">
      <div class="section-title">
        <h2>El menú Colosal</h2>
        <p>
          Desde clásicos suaves y chocolatosos hasta versiones rellenas de Nutella,
          peanut butter, Oreo, Bubulubu y s’mores.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="menu-grid">
        <div class="menu-copy">
          <h3>Un antojo, muchas opciones.</h3>
          <p>
            Nuestro menú combina sabores conocidos con cookies grandes, suaves por dentro
            y con ese toque casero que hace que quieras otra.
          </p>
          <div class="menu-points">
            <div>🍪 Cookies sencillas y rellenas</div>
            <div>🍫 Opciones con chocolate, Oreo y Hershey’s</div>
            <div>✨ Sabores especiales como s’mores y Bubulubu</div>
          </div>
          <a class="btn" style="background:#fff4df;color:#5f160f;" href="https://www.instagram.com/colosalcookies/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
            Pedir por Instagram
          </a>
        </div>

        <div class="menu-img">
          <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Menú de Colosal Cookies">
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="section" id="nosotros">
      <div class="story">
        <div class="photo">
          <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Perfil de Instagram de Colosal Cookies">
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="eyebrow">Una marca local</div>
          <h3>Hechas en Mexicali, compartidas con cariño.</h3>
          <p>
            Colosal Cookies nace con una identidad cálida, divertida y artesanal:
            una marca pensada para hacer de una cookie algo memorable.
          </p>
          <p>
            Sigue la cuenta para conocer nuevos sabores, disponibilidad, pedidos y
            novedades directamente desde Instagram.
          </p>
          <a class="btn btn-primary" id="instagram" href="https://www.instagram.com/colosalcookies/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
            Visitar Instagram
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="cta">
      <div class="cta-box">
        <div>
          <h3>¿Se te antojó?</h3>
          <p>Haz tu pedido directamente con Colosal Cookies.</p>
        </div>
        <a class="btn" href="https://www.instagram.com/colosalcookies/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
          Abrir Instagram
        </a>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>

  <footer>
    <div class="footer-inner">
      <span>© 2026 Colosal Cookies</span>
      <span>Mexicali, Baja California · @colosalcookies</span>
    </div>
  </footer>
</body>
</html>
